messages.author: 8c8975f95cb8f4df
messages.subject: Years-specific SRF
parts:
Hi

We fitted a NegBinomial INLA model to our data on fish catches. Adding a SRF (Spatial Random Field) decreased DIC substantially. See code below.
However, we know that the fish are located differently from year to year, so we want to make the SRF year-speciffic instead. The spatial correlation distance should be the same from year to year

How can we implement in the code below?

Any advice would be highly appreciated
Søren and Teunis

#* Section 8.3: Stack---- Define the stack for model M2
Stack2 <- inla.stack(
  tag = "Fit2",
  data = list(FishCount = dfModelData$FishCount ),
  A = list(1, 1, 1, A2),
  effects = list(
    Intercept = rep(1, N),  #Intercept
    X = Xm[,-1],            #Covariates without the intercept
    XDepth_m = XDepth_m,    #Smoother f(Primary
    w = w2.index))          #SRF

#* Section 8.4: Formula for the spatial NegBin GAM----
f2 <- formula(FishCount ~ -1 + Intercept +
                fYear2004 + fYear2005 + fYear2006  + #Year effects
                Xkm.std + Ykm.std + #UTM coordinates
               OtherCovariateA + OtherCovariateB + #Other linear covariates
                XDepth_m + #Smoother on depth
                f(w, model = spde2))

#* Section 8.5: Execute the spatial NegBin GAM----
M2 <- inla(f2,
           lincomb = lcs.Depth_m,
           family = "nbinomial",
           data = inla.stack.data(Stack2),
           control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
           control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(Stack2)))

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Years-specific SRF
parts:
Hi,

using argument f(..., replicate=ryear), you can for each ryear (STARTING
FROM 1, and then 2,3,4...), have a new independent realisation of the
SRF for each ryear, from the same (variance, range).

with

idx=1:n
one = rep(1,n)

then

f(idx, model="iid")
or
f(idx, model="iid", replicate=one)

is the same as

f(one, model="iid", replicate=idx)

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Years-specific SRF
parts:
When setting the spde model indices up with inla.spde.make.index, use
  w_indices <- inla.spde.make.index("w", spde$n.spde, n.repl = number_of_timepoints)
and model specification
  + f(w, model=spde,replicate=w.repl)

Similarly for inla.spde.make.A, you need to supply the replicate index for each observation as well.

Finn
